_description: Design targets for the E-Ink palette. Edit these values, then run eink-tune.py to regenerate lunaria-eink.json.

anchors._description: bg and fg define the luminance range. Hand-picked warm hexes: R > G > B for paper-like warmth.

bgHighlight.note: slightly brighter than bg, for match highlights

mediumGray.note: mid gray — secondary text, borders — computed

neutrals._description: L* targets for computed neutrals. Interpolated between bg and fg in OKLCH space to preserve warmth.

tiers._description: Three color tiers. Each tier has an L* target per hue (warm/cool asymmetry in vivid), and a chroma scale factor (< 1 = desaturate).

soft.note: Syntax highlighting body — midpoint between bg and fg.

vivid.note: Emphasis, status, errors. Warm hues lighter than cool (perceptual asymmetry). 10% desaturated for eye comfort.

hc.note: Critical elements — line numbers, links, return/throw, regexp. Must stay tight near fg (ΔL* ≥ 2).

bg_colors._description: Background washes for diff, git, search highlights. L* targets, hue/chroma from current palette.

terminal._description: ANSI 16-color terminal palette. termLow and termHigh pairs with ΔL* ≈ 15-20.

contrast.note: Above WCAG AAA (7:1) but gentler than 9.4:1 for extended reading.
